title: On My Way · Part 2
idea: Two of you said TEXT: at 12:03 am you trust the mom in the car, but the mom from the couch is standing in front of your door, smiling; the car mom texts 'I'm outside, open up', the couch mom whispers 'that isn't me out there'; same voice, same cardigan, same smile; the fox on the lawn lifts its lantern to the window, and in its light you cast a shadow on the wall and she doesn't; you run out the back into the headlights and your real mom hugs you; through the window the living room is empty, only the couch cushion still pressed down; the fox walks away; then a message from Mom, sent at 10:00 pm: 'I'm home, sweetheart. Made you tea.' Who was on your couch?
hook: Two of you said TEXT. So at 12:03 am, you trust the car. But she's standing in front of your door.
caption:
Part 2. Two of you said TEXT. 📱🚗
So you trusted the mom in the car. But the one from the couch was standing in front of your door. Still smiling.

Then the fox lifted its lantern to the window. 🦊🏮 You cast a shadow on the wall. She didn't.

Your real mom is safe with you now. But one message from her phone was sent at 10:00 pm: "I'm home, sweetheart. Made you tea."

So who was on your couch? Tell me in the comments 👇
first_comment: Who was on your couch? 🛋️ Best theory gets pinned 🦊🏮
